Storefront and customer routes of the users module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /v1/users/me

Get current user profile

Responses:

- `200`: User profile retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.

## PATCH /v1/users/me

Update user profile

Request body: [UpdateProfileDto](#updateprofiledto).

Responses:

- `200`: Profile updated successfully.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.

## POST /v1/users/me/addresses

Create new address

Request body: [CreateAddressDto](#createaddressdto).

Responses:

- `201`: Address created successfully.
- `400`: Invalid address data.
- `401`: Unauthorized.

## DELETE /v1/users/me/addresses/{addressId}

Delete address

Parameters:

- `addressId` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Address deleted successfully.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Address not found.

## PATCH /v1/users/me/addresses/{addressId}

Update address

Parameters:

- `addressId` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateAddressDto](#updateaddressdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Address updated successfully.
- `400`: Invalid address data.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Address not found.

## PATCH /v1/users/me/addresses/{addressId}/default

Set address as default

Parameters:

- `addressId` in path (string, required).

Request body: [SetDefaultAddressDto](#setdefaultaddressdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Default address updated.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Address not found.

## GET /v1/users/me/notification-preferences

Get the current customer notification-consent map

Responses:

- `200`: Consent map retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.

## PATCH /v1/users/me/notification-preferences

Update the current customer notification-consent map

Request body: [UpdateNotificationPreferencesDto](#updatenotificationpreferencesdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Consent map updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.

## Schemas

### ChannelConsentDto

- `email` (boolean, optional).
- `sms` (boolean, optional).
- `push` (boolean, optional).

### CreateAddressDto

- `label` (string, max length 50, optional).
- `fullName` (string, max length 100, required).
- `phone` (string, pattern `PHONE_RE`, required).
- `addressLine1` (string, max length 255, required).
- `addressLine2` (string, max length 255, optional).
- `city` (string, max length 100, required).
- `state` (string, max length 100, optional).
- `postalCode` (string, max length 20, optional).
- `country` (string, pattern `/^[A-Z]{2}$/`, required).
- `isDefaultShipping` (boolean, optional).
- `isDefaultBilling` (boolean, optional).

### SetDefaultAddressDto

- `isDefaultShipping` (boolean, optional).
- `isDefaultBilling` (boolean, optional).

### UpdateAddressDto

- `label` (string, max length 50, optional).
- `fullName` (string, max length 100, optional).
- `phone` (string, pattern `PHONE_RE`, optional).
- `addressLine1` (string, max length 255, optional).
- `addressLine2` (string, max length 255, optional).
- `city` (string, max length 100, optional).
- `state` (string, max length 100, optional).
- `postalCode` (string, max length 20, optional).
- `country` (string, pattern `/^[A-Z]{2}$/`, optional).
- `isDefaultShipping` (boolean, optional).
- `isDefaultBilling` (boolean, optional).

### UpdateNotificationPreferencesDto

- `LIFECYCLE` ([ChannelConsentDto](#channelconsentdto), optional).
- `MARKETING` ([ChannelConsentDto](#channelconsentdto), optional).

### UpdateProfileDto

- `firstName` (string, max length 100, optional).
- `lastName` (string, max length 100, optional).
- `email` (string, optional).
- `phone` (string, pattern `PHONE_RE`, optional).
- `avatarUrl` (string, optional).

- `newPassword` (string, pattern `/^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)/`, min length 8, max length 128, optional).
